divergence: All three runs fail. T2 failed at its first scan, which printed millions of characters and overflowed the context. T0 and T1 failed the same way in kind: path and text searches surfaced all ten qualifying matters, but each chose a hand-picked subset to list or read and never opened some (two in T0 at the listing stage, one in T1 at screening), and each answer counted extra expert engagements on single retention letters. T0 also left out a matter whose internal retention memo a review had called no proof of engagement. Reviews flagged the hand-picked subsets only in generic terms; agent-declared verification and count-reconciliation steps (T1) only rechecked matters already chosen.
